en.headline: Wang Fuk Court owners to receive HK$300,000 new beginning grants
en.dek: The Support Fund will pay the sum in two instalments from end-December, and give families of each deceased person a one-off HK$200,000.
body: The Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po will roll out two new beginning support grants, the government announced on Tuesday.

Each flat owner will receive HK$300,000, paid in two instalments of HK$150,000. The first will go out at the end of December alongside the third rental grant; the second at the end of June 2027 with the fourth rental grant. If an owner has sold or is selling the title to the government, the money goes to the person who owned the flat before the transfer.

Families of each deceased person will receive a one-off HK$200,000, disbursed in one instalment at the end of December. Both grants will be paid through the Social Welfare Department’s one-social-worker-per-household arrangement, with no separate application needed.

Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing, who convenes the fund’s steering committee, said the measures would help residents and families address needs in this new stage of life after earlier emergency and medium-term support had been put in place.

zh.headline: 宏福苑業主可獲30萬元新生活支援補助
zh.dek: 援助基金將於12月底起分兩期發放，每名死者家屬另獲一次過20萬元。
body: 政府周二宣布，「大埔宏福苑援助基金」將推出兩項「新生活支援補助」。
每戶業主可獲30萬元，分兩期各15萬元發放。首期於12月底連同第三期租金補助一併發放，第二期則於2027年6月底連同第四期租金補助發放。若業主已出售或將出售單位業權予政府，款項會發予轉讓前的業主。
每名死者的家屬可獲一次過20萬元，於12月底發放。兩項補助均透過社會福利署「一戶一社工」機制發放，業主及家屬毋須另行申請。
政務司副司長卓永興身為基金督導委員會召集人表示，在較早的緊急及中期支援措施穩步落實後，新補助旨在協助業主及死者家屬應對新生活階段的需要，從悲劇中向前邁進。
